title: Classic, Wide Note Margin
description: The Classic page with a wide outer margin divided from the text by a faint rule, for the reader's own notes. The look of the Councils, Papal Documents and Summa volumes.
best_for: Study editions: council decrees, encyclicals, theology, anything people annotate.

note_rule.help: the faint rule beside the note margin

colour: black and white (canon and creed bars print grey)
